briefdescription.para: Find a subrange corresponding to the exact lane mask LM in the live interval LI.

detaileddescription.para: The interval LI is assumed to contain such a subrange. This function is used to find corresponding subranges between the original interval and the new intervals.

briefdescription.para: Find a subrange corresponding to the lane mask LM, or a superset of it, in the live interval LI.

detaileddescription.para: The interval LI is assumed to contain such a subrange. This function is used to find corresponding subranges between the original interval and the new intervals.
